user.text:
I want a small app for keeping track of the books I'm reading.

When I open it I want to see what I'm currently reading and what I've finished. I want to add a book from a form, mark one as finished, and click through to a book to see its title, author and my notes. I'd like to be able to send someone a link to a single book.

Nothing fancy and no accounts. Skip the database, save the books to a JSON file so they're still there after a restart.

history.assistant:
Open it with `npm start`, then go to http://localhost:3000. The home page shows what you are currently reading and what you have finished, plus a form to add a title, author, and notes.

Each book has its own page at `/books/<id>` with the title, author, and notes. That address is the link you can send someone. Use "Mark as finished" on the list or the book page to move it to the finished shelf.

Books are saved in `data/books.json`, so they are still there after a restart. There are no accounts. `npm test` passed, 3 tests.
